about: Per-ticker build log for the relationship maps (data/chain). Universe: company introductions (lib/research/company-introductions.data.json). Rule (#806, owner update 2026-11-28): the target is five or more companies whose relationship is quoted from an official filing or document; a map with exactly four such companies is also published and marked ready_four (upgrade to five when a fifth is verified); never fewer than four and never an unverified company. Statuses: ready (five or more), ready_four (exactly four; upgrade_target 5), below_five (published before the rule; kept until the owner decides), skipped (tried; fewer than four verified companies; reason recorded), not_attempted.
